# DuckDB-backed stats store (backend/stats_writer.py, agent_run_tracker.py,
# cost_tracker.py, etc.) — was previously installed only by accident in some
# dev environments; never declared here until D#1575 traced ts-backend's
# python3-shellout parity tests failing in CI to this gap.
duckdb>=1.5.2
# duckdb's Python binding needs pytz internally when binding timezone-aware
# datetimes (e.g. agent_run_tracker's start_ts/end_ts columns) — without it,
# every write silently no-ops (duckdb.InvalidInputException swallowed by
# agent_run_tracker's non-fatal error handling). Also only ever present by
# accident via some other package's transitive dependency in dev environments.
pytz>=2024.1
# backend/server.py imports sqlalchemy directly; was previously present only
# by accident in dev/agent environments, never declared here — this is what
# broke the "backend (import-smoke)" GitHub Actions job on a clean install.
sqlalchemy>=2.0.49
# structlog's only importer was a module in the Python CLI port that used
# to ship from this repo's root; that tree was retired and archived (see
# git history around 2026-08-17) and ships nowhere in the live tree now.
# Added here for the same ambient-only gap as sqlalchemy above, back when
# that importer was still live. Looks dead now; removing the declared
# dependency is a separate follow-up since it's a behavioural/CI-exposure
# change, not a comment fix.
structlog>=25.5.0

# Test dependencies
pytest-testmon>=2.2.0
pytest-picked>=0.5.1
# pytest.ini sets asyncio_mode = auto (needed for every @pytest.mark.asyncio
# test across backend/tests/) but the plugin providing that marker was never
# declared here — same "worked by accident in dev environments" gap as
# duckdb/sqlalchemy/structlog above. Without it every async test in the repo
# collects fine and then fails at runtime with "async def functions are not
# natively supported."
pytest-asyncio>=0.24.0
